```python
import sys

import griffe


def main() -> int:
    package_name = "mypkg"
    repo = "."

    old_package = griffe.load_git(package_name, ref="v1.0.0", repo=repo)
    new_package = griffe.load_git(package_name, ref="HEAD", repo=repo)

    breakages = list(griffe.find_breaking_changes(old_package, new_package))

    for breakage in breakages:
        print(breakage.as_str())

    return 1 if breakages else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```
